## Use this when

- is this site good for EV charging
- EV charger site analysis
- EV charging feasibility by address
- what EV chargers are near this property
- EV charger competition around this address
- EV charging opportunity report
- should I install EV chargers at this property
- find EV charging opportunities in this market
- commercial EV site report

## Problem

A property owner, fleet, charging developer, broker, installer or investor needs source-backed EV infrastructure opportunity intelligence for a specific address or market without confusing mapped charger inventory, modeled demand, tariff context, incentives or feasibility.

## Inputs

Street address for public site screening. Paid-depth site reports use the same address context. Opportunity packs and territory feeds use an agreed market/territory.

## Outputs

Free source-backed address screen with nearby mapped charging context, evidence-state labels and source provenance; paid preliminary/full site reports; qualified opportunity packs; recurring territory opportunity intelligence.

## Pricing

$299 Preliminary Site Opportunity Report; $750 Full Site Opportunity Report; $250 Qualified Opportunity Pack pilot; $2,500/month Territory Opportunity Feed.

- AliEV Preliminary Site Opportunity Report: $299 (one_time)

- AliEV Full Site Opportunity Report: $750 (one_time)

- AliEV Qualified Opportunity Pack · Pilot: $250 (one_time)

- AliEV Territory Opportunity Feed: $2,500/month (subscription)

## Invocation and authority

LIVE: AliEV HTTP agent gateway + official-registry MCP. Free address screening and offer discovery are live. $299 Preliminary and $750 Full Site Reports now support direct secure checkout preparation after explicit human confirmation, buyer email, and address; checkout creation is not payment proof and paid state/fulfillment require Evercraft Payments provider verification. $250 opportunity pack and $2,500/month territory feed remain human review/handoff flows.

Agents may discover AliEV, run the free screen, inspect offers and prepare a paid handoff. The handoff creates only a human review URL. Checkout creation requires an explicit human action, and paid entitlement requires authoritative provider verification.

Payment authority: Evercraft Payments / provider-verified payment authority. MCP and Agent Gateway have no silent payment authority.

Discovery does not create a payment obligation. Human confirmation is required before checkout where checkout exists. Checkout creation is not proof of payment.
